title: TR-EIF Active Ternary Execution State
description: Structural JSON schema for one retained balanced-ternary execution state. The canonical state space is -1/0/1. State 0 is an active neutral execution state used for balancing, routing, damping, mediation, transition staging, retention, and controlled neutralization; it is not a passive null value and must not encode missing, invalid, NaN, error, unknown, or abstention states.

retained_state.description: Executed retained ternary state. Value 0 is the active neutral state.

pending_target.description: Optional nonneutral target retained while execution is staged through active neutral state 0. Pending target is distinct from executed state.

$comment: TR-EIF balanced ternary semantics: 0 is an active neutral execution state supporting balancing, routing, damping, mediation, transition staging, retention, and controlled neutralization. It is not missing data, invalid data, NaN, error, unknown, or abstention. pending_target != retained_state and pending_target != active neutral. A non-null pending_target is permitted only while retained_state == 0. Direct committed -1 -> 1 and 1 -> -1 transitions are forbidden; opposite-polarity execution requires separate committed events -1 -> 0 -> 1 or 1 -> 0 -> -1. target != executed state and pending != neutral.
